Scrollbar matrix (observe; nothing here is a pass by itself)

Each case reports computed overflow, scrollbar-width, scrollbar-color and offsetWidth - clientWidth; root and frame documents report innerWidth - clientWidth of the root element instead (0 usually means no space-taking scrollbar; macOS overlay scrollbars also report 0, so record the macOS "Show scroll bars" mode first). The visual observation decides; the number only supports it.

Case 5: the page itself is taller than the window; its root scrollbar must be visible despite root hiding.

1 author scrollbar-width:none
2 author !important
3 @layer !important
4 inline !important
6 same-origin iframe with root hiding
7 cross-origin iframe (other loopback host) with root hiding
8 srcdoc iframe with root hiding
9 overflow:hidden with overflowing content: no scrollbar, overflow still hidden
10 overflow:auto without overflow: no scrollbar
11 ::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
12 ::-webkit-scrollbar{width:0;height:0}
13 scrollbar-color: transparent transparent
14 scroller inside open shadow root with scrollbar-width:none
15 author thin: normalized to normal width
16 scrollbar-width:none plus ::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
17 WebKit transparent scrollbar, thumb and track
18 nested scroll boxes; the inner one hides (standard plus WebKit); both bars visible
19 script-populated about:blank iframe with root hiding
20 sandboxed srcdoc iframe (opaque origin) with root hiding
21 data: iframe with root hiding
22 blob: iframe with root hiding
23 standard transparent color plus WebKit transparent thumb and track
24 overflow:visible box with tall content: stays non-scrollable, no scrollbar
25 scroller whose bar is clipped off by an overflow:hidden parent (documented limit)
26 color-scheme:dark scroller: bar visible and distinguishable
27 dark background without color-scheme: bar visible; note the light track stripe for manager review
